82,672,504 pledged shares held by public shareholders create forced-selling risk that can pressure the price after listing regardless of fundamentals.
The prospectus itself flags that losing trading members or failing to onboard new ones would hurt the business, and the revenue base is transaction-driven.
The figure suite implies a 61% revenue collapse in the latest year while the document claims 5.98% growth; one of these is wrong, and not knowing which makes the valuation base unreliable.
